sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Suffers an Accident and Is Arrested in Florida Days After His Return to Golf
sources.text:
Tiger Woods sufre aparatoso accidente y es arrestado en Florida a días de su regreso al golf
Tiger Woods sufre aparatoso accidente y es arrestado en Florida a días de su regreso al golf
- Redacción AN/ SBH
El golfista Tiger Woods, de 50 años, estuvo involucrado en un accidente automovilístico con volcadura el viernes por la tarde en Jupiter, Florida. Tras el incidente, fue arrestado por las autoridades.
De acuerdo con información de TMZ, el incidente ocurrió alrededor de las 14:00 horas (tiempo del este), cuando Woods conducía su vehículo Range Rover a alta velocidad por una calle de dos carriles.
El automóvil rozó una camioneta que intentaba ingresar a un camino de entrada, lo que provocó que el vehículo volcara sobre el lado del conductor, dice el medio especializado en espectáculos.
Woods logró salir por la ventana del lado del copiloto, pero los oficiales que acudieron a la escena notaron que el deportista parecía somnoliento y bajo los efectos de alguna sustancia. Aunque la prueba de alcoholemia registró un nivel de 0.00%, el sheriff señaló en una conferencia de prensa que la policía consideró que Woods no estaba bajo los efectos del alcohol, sino de medicamentos.
Tras el choque, Woods fue arrestado bajo los cargos de conducir bajo la influencia (DUI, por sus siglas en inglés) y por negarse a someterse a una prueba de orina en la estación de policía.
Según información de ABC News, citada por la agencia Reuters, el estado de salud de Woods no fue aclarado de inmediato tras la volcadura.
La tarde de este viernes Donald Trump, presidente de Estados Unidos, habló con la prensa sobre el accidente que sufrió su amigo Tiger:
“Lo siento mucho. Él (Tiger Woods) tiene algunas dificultades. Hubo un accidente, y eso es todo lo que sé. Es un amigo muy cercano mío. Es una persona increíble. Un hombre increíble. Pero tiene algunas dificultades”.
Accidente crítico
Este arresto llegó en un momento crítico para Woods, quien apenas el martes 24 de marzo marcó su regreso al golf competitivo al participar en las finales de la liga TGL en Florida, que cofundó el año pasado junto a Rory McIlroy. Según reportes de Reuters, en dicho evento su equipo (Jupiter Links Golf Club) cayó 9-2 frente a Los Angeles Golf Club.
A pesar de haber mantenido un calendario limitado tras su anterior choque automovilístico en febrero de 2021 y de no competir en el PGA Tour desde que quedó fuera del Abierto Británico en 2024, su reciente participación en la liga bajo techo dio esperanzas a sus seguidores de que pudiera competir en el próximo torneo Masters en Augusta, que comienza el 9 de abril.
El ganador de 15 títulos major ha lidiado con severos problemas físicos en los últimos tiempos; durante la primavera pasada sufrió una ruptura del tendón de Aquiles izquierdo y en octubre se sometió a una cirugía de reemplazo de disco lumbar.
Durante un evento de TGL el 17 de marzo, Reuters reportó que Woods habló sobre el doloroso proceso: “He estado trabajando en ello. A veces tengo días buenos, a veces tengo días malos. El reemplazo de disco no es muy divertido”.
Días después, en una conferencia de prensa, reafirmó su intención de competir en Augusta: “Sigo intentándolo. Quiero jugar. Amo el torneo […] y voy a estar ahí de una u otra forma”. Sin embargo, admitió con honestidad los estragos de sus múltiples cirugías al declarar que “este cuerpo no se recupera como cuando tenía 24 o 25 años”.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods DUI Charges After Florida Crash
sources.text:
Tiger Woods was arrested Friday afternoon after a rollover crash on Jupiter Island, according to local authorities.
Officials in Martin County say the crash happened just after 2 p.m. near 281 Beach Road, which is close to Woods’ home. The Martin County Sheriff’s Office confirmed that Woods was taken into custody on suspicion of DUI following the incident.
Video from the scene showed a Range Rover flipped onto its side, highlighting the seriousness of the crash. However, Sheriff John Budensiek said during a Friday evening news conference that it “did not appear that Woods was hurt.”
Authorities said Woods complied with a breathalyzer test but refused to submit to a urine test. He now faces misdemeanor charges and will be held in the Martin County Jail for at least eight hours.
This is not Woods’ first run-in with a DUI-related case. In 2017, he was arrested in Palm Beach County on suspicion of driving under the influence. He later pleaded guilty to reckless driving, paid a $250 fine, and completed DUI school.
The latest incident also brings renewed attention to Woods’ past crash in California in 2021, where he suffered multiple leg injuries. Officials say the investigation into Friday’s crash is still ongoing.

Tajger Vuds uhapšen je u petak, pod sumnjom da je vozio pod uticajem alkohola, prema rečima šerifa okruga Martin Džona Budensika.

Tajger Vuds je vozio "land rover" i zakačio pikap koji je vukao malu prikolicu, rekao je Budensik novinarima. Sudar je doveo do toga da se Vudsov "land rover" prevrne na bok, piše CNN.
Kada je policija stigla na mesto nesreće, Vuds je pokazivao znake alkoholisanosti, rekao je Budensik.
„Naši istražitelji za vožnju pod uticajem alkohola došli su na lice mesta. I gospodin Vuds je pokazivao znake alkoholisanosti“, rekao je Budensik.
Istraga je pokazala da je Vuds vozio nestabilno neposredno pre nesreće.
„Naša istraga je pokazala sledeće: Neposredno pre 14 časova, vozilo za pranje pod pritiskom koje je vuklo malu prikolicu kretalo se na sever putem South Beach Road i pripremalo se da skrene u prilaz. Usporavalo je i započelo skretanje, a vozač tog vozila pogledao je u retrovizor i video 'land rover', tamne boje, kako ga velikom brzinom sustiže. Ne znam tačnu brzinu.“
Dodao je:
„'Land rover' ga je nastavio sustizati. Video ga je kako dolazi, pa je pokušao da se pomeri uz ivicu puta. Međutim, to je uzak put sa dve trake i nije bilo mesta sa strane gde bi ovaj čovek mogao da se skloni. Dok je pokušavao da se pomeri u stranu, 'land rover' ga je sustigao i u poslednjem trenutku skrenuo da izbegne sudar, ali je zakačio zadnji deo prikolice uređaja za pranje pod pritiskom, nagnuo se u stranu i zatim se prevrnuo na vozačeva vrata, prošavši pored kamiona koji je upravo izbegao sudar.“
Zaključio je:
„Osoba koja je vozila taj 'land rover' uspela je da ispuzi kroz suvozačeva vrata i identifikovana je kao gospodin Tajger Vuds.“

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Involved in a Car Accident and Arrested for Driving Under the Influence of Substance
sources.text:
Tiger Woods, qui avait été gravement blessé dans un accident de voiture en 2021, a été arrêté pour conduite sous l'emprise d'une substance, après que son Land Rover s'est retourné sur une route à deux voies près de son domicile en Floride, a appris le bureau des forces de l'ordre locales. On ne sait pas si la légende américaine a été blessée dans cet accident survenu à Jupiter Island, à environ 150 kilomètres au nord de Miami, selon la chaîne de télévision ABC.
Woods présentait des signes d'altération et a refusé de se soumettre à un test urinaire en détention. Un alcootest n'a révélé aucune trace d'alcool, les enquêteurs estimant que son état était lié à la prise de drogues ou de médicaments. La chaîne locale WPTV, affiliée à NBC, a diffusé des images du lieu de l'accident montrant un véhicule SUV renversé sur le flanc.
Woods était tout proche de disputer le Masters
Le joueur de 50 ans est en train d'essayer de revenir à la compétition après une rupture d'un tendon d'Achille en mars de l'année dernière et une opération du dos en octobre. Ainsi, il n'excluait pas de disputer le Masters le mois prochain. Tiger Woods n'a plus disputé de compétition depuis juillet 2024.
Le golfeur aux 15 victoires dans des tournois du Grand Chelem avait été sérieusement blessé à la jambe droite dans un accident de voiture en 2021 en Californie. Il avait également été impliqué dans un accident de la route en 2017, dans lequel il avait été soupçonné de conduite en état d'ivresse. Il avait par la suite plaidé coupable de conduite imprudente et s'était vu infliger une amende de 250 dollars. Il avait également suivi un stage de sensibilisation.

sources.news_title: Golf: Tiger Woods Siktet for Ruspåvirket Kjøringetter Bilulykke
sources.text:
Det opplyser politiet fredag kveld, ifølge AFP og AP.
Ulykken skjedde like etter klokken 14 amerikansk tid i West Palm Beach. Woods slapp fra ulykken uten alvorlige skader.
Politisjefen i Martin County, John Budensiek, opplyste på en pressekonferanse at Woods gikk med på å ta en promilletest som sjekket for alkohol, men at han deretter nektet å være med på videre undersøkelser.
– Da vi ba om en urinprøve, nektet han, og derfor er han siktet for kjøring i påvirket tilstand, skadeverk og for å nekte å ta en lovpålagt test i forbindelse med ulykken, sa Budensiek.
Åtte timer senere ble han løslatt mot kausjon for det laveste beløpet loven tillater. Politiet mener Woods kan ha vært påvirket av medisiner eller andre stoffer.
– Han er samarbeidsvillig, men var forsiktig med hva han sa og ikke sa, utdypet Budensiek på en pressekonferanse.
– Trist
HBO Max' golfekspert Marius Thorp synes det var trist å lese om hendelsen.
– Han har jo vært gjennom så mye utenomsportslige ting nå, og man hadde jo et håp om at ting var på et mye bedre sted, sier han til NRK.
Woods har møtt på mye motgang de siste årene. Han har slitt med en rekke skader, og i fjor mistet han moren sin.
Det er blant årsakene til at han ikke har spilt en PGA-turnering siden The Open Championship i 2024.
– Vi får bare vente og se til mer informasjon kommer, men det er trist å lese slike nyheter om en av vår sports største gjennom tidene, legger Thorp til.
Woods ble også i 2017 pågrepet for kjøring i påvirket tilstand. I etterkant beklaget han hendelsen og forklarte den med en «uventet reaksjon» på en medisin han tok.
I retten erkjente han straffskyld for uforsvarlig kjøring og betalte en bot på 250 dollar, samt at han måtte delta på et kurs om kjøring i ruspåvirket tilstand.
Trump-beskjed
Woods ble i 2021 alvorlig skadet i en bilulykke i Los Angeles. Siden det har han spilt svært få golfturneringer, men nylig opplyste han at han var på bedringens vei etter en operasjon og at han ville jobbe for å stille i majorturneringen The Masters i april.
I etterkant av fredagens hendelse har USAs president Donald Trump uttalt seg om den amerikanske golfstjernen.
– Jeg har så vondt av ham. Han har noen problemer. Det var en ulykke. Det er alt jeg vet. Han er en nær venn og et fantastisk menneske. Men han har noen problemer. Jeg vil ikke snakke om det, sa Trump til et stort pressekorps på en flystripe.
Den amerikanske presidenten er en stor tilhenger av golfsporten, og har lenge hatt et godt forhold til Woods.
I 2019 fikk han USAs høyeste sivilutmerkelse, «Presidential Medal of Freedom». Det skjedde etter at den amerikanske golflegenden gikk til topps i The Masters.
Trump har tidligere beskrevet Woods som «en nær venn» og «en fantastisk person».
Tidligere fredag skrev flere medier at Woods er påmeldt årets utgave av US Open for seniorspillere.
Woods er blant tidenes beste golfspillere og deler rekorden på antall PGA-seirer med Sam Snead på 82.
50-åringen har i tillegg vunnet alle fire majorturneringer opptil flere ganger.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Arrested And Charged With DUI After Being Involved In Rollover Crash
sources.text:
Tiger Woods Arrested And Charged With DUI After Rollover Crash In Florida
Golf legend Tiger Woods was arrested in Jupiter, Florida, following a rollover crash involving his vehicle. According to law enforcement, Woods was driving at a high speed when the incident occurred.
The crash took place around 2 PM ET. Authorities reported that a pickup truck was turning into a driveway on a two-lane road when Woods’ vehicle attempted to pass. During that maneuver, Woods’ vehicle clipped the truck, which led to a loss of control and caused the Land Rover to overturn.
Emergency responders arrived shortly after the crash. Officials confirmed that Woods was conscious at the scene. He was later taken into custody as part of the investigation. At this time, authorities have not released additional details regarding injuries.
Law Enforcement Provides Details On DUI Arrest
During a news conference on Friday, law enforcement officials provided an update on the incident. According to authorities, Woods was arrested and charged with driving under the influence following their investigation at the scene.
Officials stated that speed was a contributing factor in the crash. They also confirmed that the attempted pass on a narrow roadway played a role in the collision. The investigation remains ongoing as authorities continue to review the circumstances surrounding the incident.
No fatalities were reported. However, officials emphasized the seriousness of the crash. Additional details, including results from any testing conducted, have not yet been publicly released.
Timeline Of Events Leading To The Rollover Crash
Based on information provided by authorities, the sequence of events began with Woods traveling at a high rate of speed on a two-lane road. At the same time, a pickup truck was turning into a residential driveway.
As Woods’ vehicle attempted to pass the truck, contact occurred between the two vehicles. That contact caused Woods’ vehicle to lose stability. As a result, the Land Rover overturned, coming to rest at the scene.
Law enforcement secured the area and began their investigation immediately. First responders assessed those involved and ensured that the roadway was safe for traffic. Officials later conducted an on-site evaluation, which led to Woods’ arrest.
Authorities have not indicated whether additional charges may be filed. The case remains under review.

sources.news_title: Florida Accident: Tiger Woods Arrested for "Impaired Driving"
What We Know About the Tiger Woods Accident in Florida
sources.text:
Lo que necesitas saber:
De acuerdo con algunos testigos, ninguno de los implicados en el accidente sufrió daños graves.
Tiger Woods sufrió un accidente automovilístico cerca de la zona de Jupiter Island en Florida, cerca de donde se encuentra su domicilio. El sheriff del condado de Martin, John Budensiek, confirmó que el exgolfista fue detenido, acusado de manejar bajo los efectos de alguna sustancia.
Woods, permanecerá bajo custodia de las autoridades, aunque no con el resto de los reclusos, estará aislado por su seguridad. Budensiek aseguró que no habrá excepciones y Tiger deberá cumplir su castigo: “No importa quién seas: si infringes la ley, la haremos cumplir”.
¿Qué le pasó a Tiger Woods?
De acuerdo con TMZ, en el accidente de Tiger Woods estuvieron involucrados dos vehículos. Afortunadamente ninguno de los implicados sufrió daños graves, según un testigo, Woods se encontraba fuera de peligro.
El accidente se registró exactamente en el Beach Road, en Jupiter Island, según la Oficina del Sheriff del Condado de Martin.
Y aunque fue detenido por conducir bajo los efectos del alcohol, tras negarse a someterse a las pruebas de orina, Budensiek aclaró que Woods parecía estar bajo los efectos de un medicamento.
Está no es la primera vez que Woods se ve involucrado en un accidente automovilístico; por allá del 2021, sufrió fracturas en la tibia y peroné después de un choque en Los Ángeles.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods in Traffic Accident: Charged with Drunk Driving
sources.text:
Den amerikanske golfstjerne Tiger Woods er fredag blevet anholdt af politiet i Florida for at have kørt bil i påvirket tilstand.
Det oplyser politiet ifølge nyhedsbureauet AFP.
Tidligere fredag kom der oplysninger om, at Woods havde været involveret i en soloulykke i sin bil, som endte med at ligge på taget.
På et pressemøde har politiet nu oplyst, at Woods var påvirket, da han kørte, hvorfor han nu er blevet anholdt.
Politiet forklarer videre, at der ikke er nogen, der er kommet til skade i uheldet, men at det kunne have endt meget værre, end det gjorde.
Woods kravlede selv ud af passagersædet, inden politiet ankom til ulykkesstedet. Han var alene i bilen.
Golfstjernen havde angiveligt forsøgt at overhale en lastbil i høj fart, som han så ramte, da der ikke var nok plads på vejen.
Trump reagerer
Den amerikanske præsident Donald Trump er blevet spurgt ind til, hvordan han forholder sig til ulykken, hvilket han ikke gider svare på.
Han fortæller dog, at han og Woods er tætte venner.
- Jeg har det så dårligt. Han har nogle problemer, det er alt, jeg ved. Han er en af mine meget tætte venner og en fantastisk person, en fantastisk mand.
- En god mand, der har nogle problemer. Jeg vil ikke snakke om det, slutter Trump, ifølge Sky News.
Ikke første gang
50-årige Tiger Woods har flere gange været impliceret i uheldige episoder, hvor han som chauffør har været involveret.
Tilbage i 2021 var han ved at miste livet, da han mistede kontrollen over sin bil og ramte et træ, før bilen roterede.
Woods pådrog sig efter ulykken et åbent benbrud, der betød, at hans vilde golfkarriere var i stor fare. Skaden krævede nemlig flere operationer og en lang, lang genoptræning, inden han kunne spille golf igen.
I 2017 blev Woods taget for spirituskørsel og modtog en dom for sin forseelse.
Amerikaneren var angiveligt så fuld, at han ikke var i stand til at puste ind i alkometeret, skriver The Sun.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods, Arrested for Refusing Urine Proof After an Accident From Which He Was Unharmed
sources.text:
Golf
Tiger Woods, detenido por negarse a prueba de orina tras un accidente del que salió ileso
Una fotografía del lugar mostró el vehículo volcado sobre el costado del conductor
EFE
El golfista Tiger Woods, ganador de 15 'grandes', fue detenido este viernes por daños a la propiedad y por negarse a una prueba de orina tras verse involucrado en un accidente de carretera en Jupiter Island, en Florida (EE.UU.), del que salió ileso, según informó la oficina del alguacil del condado de Martin. Una fotografía del lugar mostró el vehículo volcado sobre el costado del conductor
"Ha sido acusado de conducir bajo la influencia (DUI) con daños a la propiedad y de negarse a someterse a una prueba legal", dijo en una rueda de prensa un oficial de la oficina del alguacil, que no se identificó, precisando que el golfista dio negativo en la prueba de alcohol, pero mostraba signos de "deterioro".
El policía agregó que el deportista permanecerá al menos ocho horas en la cárcel del Condado de Martin, después de lo que será puesto en libertad bajo fianza.
Woods viajaba solo en el momento del accidente.
Además, el oficial agregó que "fue cooperativo, aunque no quiso incriminarse a sí mismo", y que se encontraba "letárgico en la escena" del hecho.
El accidente tuvo lugar poco antes de las 14:00 hora local (18:00 GMT) cuando el vehículo conducido por Woods intentó rebasar "a gran velocidad" a una camioneta con remolque en una carretera estrecha, pero terminó golpeando la parte trasera del otro vehículo y volcando sobre el lado del conductor.
"Se inició la investigación e, inicialmente, desde el primer momento, pareció que el conductor del Land Rover (Tiger Woods) podría estar bajo los efectos de alguna sustancia", indicó.
No es la primera vez que Woods sufre un accidente de carretera. En febrero de 2021 sufrió fracturas abiertas en tibia y peroné tras un grave accidente en Los Ángeles que puso en serio peligro su carrera.
Woods estaba trabajando para volver a competir después de romperse el tendón de Aquiles en 2025.

sources.text:
Tiger Woods has been arrested and will spend eight hours in jail on suspicion of DUI after a two-vehicle accident near his home in Jupiter, Florida.

sources.news_title: Golf Legend Tiger Woods Arrested After Rollover Crash in Florida: '5 Years Later and It Happens Again'
sources.text:
Golfing legend Tiger Woods was involved in a rollover crash in Florida, according to local authorities. He has since been arrested and charged with driving under the influence in connection with the incident.
As reported by WPTV, citing the Martin County Sheriff’s Office, the accident occurred near 281 Beach Road on Jupiter Island, Florida. At around 2 p.m., authorities responded to the crash scene, and, as shown in a photo taken by the outlet, a Range Rover was found on its side.
TMZ cited an eyewitness who was at the scene at the time of the Florida crash, who said that the incident involved two vehicles. The witness reportedly saw Tiger at the scene and said that no one involved was seriously injured.
Martin County Sheriff John Budensiek then revealed that Tiger showed “signs of impairment,” CBS Sports detailed. Allegedly, while he agreed to a Breathalyzer test, he refused to provide a urine sample. As a result, he was arrested and charged with driving under the influence, property damage, and refusal to submit a lawful test.
Past Driving Incidents
This incident comes more than five years after Tiger was involved in a serious single-car accident in California. The golfer suffered open fractures to the right leg, and surgery was required. According to a statement shared by Tiger, a rod was inserted into his tibia, and further injuries were stabilized “with a combination of screws and pins.”
Los Angeles County Sheriff Alex Villanueva revealed in a news conference that Tiger was driving at 84 to 87 mph in a 45 mph zone, ABC News reported at the time. Villanueva revealed that Tiger had accidentally hit the accelerator, mistaking it for the brake. This led to him crashing into a tree.
Years before the California accident, in 2017, Tiger Woods was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence, ABC News reported. This occurred in Jupiter, Florida, close to where his latest crash took place. Woods was then released and apologized for the incident.
Online Reactions
Reactions to Tiger’s later crash were many. Some users referenced the previous crash, with one user saying, “5 years later and it happens again. Oh my.” Similarly, another commenter said, “Dude just needs to stop driving.”
Other users chose to wish for Tiger’s well-being and recovery, with one person writing, “Prayers to Tiger.” Another one agreed, saying, “I hope he’s okay for his sake and his family. Thoughts and prayers.”
As per Reuters, given that Tiger’s charges are all misdemeanors, he will remain in prison for at least eight hours. Then, the golfing legend will be released on bond.

sources.news_title: Golf Icon Woods Arrested After Car Accident
sources.text:
US-Golfstar Tiger Woods ist wenige Stunden nach seiner Festnahme in den USA wegen Drogenverdachts auf Kaution freigelassen worden. Das teilte eine Sprecherin des Sheriff-Büros von Martin County Medienberichten zufolge mit. Kurz zuvor war der 50-Jährige nach einem Autounfall wegen Drogenverdachts festgenommen worden.
Ein Atemalkoholtest habe zwar einen Wert von null angezeigt. Einen Urintest habe Woods aber nicht machen wollen. Die Ermittler vermuten, dass er "irgendein Medikament oder eine Droge" zu sich genommen habe. Woods war bei dem Unfall unverletzt geblieben. Die Höhe der Kaution war zunächst nicht bekannt.
Woods musste mindestens acht Stunden lang im Gefängnis bleiben und konnte erst dann gegen Kaution freigelassen werden. John Budensiek vom Martin County Sheriff-Büro hatte nach der Festnahme gesagt, der Golfstar habe am Tatort lethargisch gewirkt. "Wir glauben, dass das auf die Substanz zurückzuführen war, unter deren Einfluss er stand." Er sei wegen Fahruntüchtigkeit am Steuer und Verweigerung eines Tests im Zusammenhang mit dem Unfall angeklagt worden.
Unfall bereits vor fünf Jahren
Nach Angaben des Sheriffs soll Woods in einem Geländewagen mit hoher Geschwindigkeit zum Überholen eines Fahrzeugs angesetzt haben, das zugleich abbiegen wollte. Woods' Geländewagen streifte dabei den Anhänger des anderen Fahrzeugs, kippte auf die Seite und schlitterte über die Fahrbahn. Verletzt wurde bei dem Unfall laut Sheriff niemand.
Woods war bereits im Februar 2021 in Los Angeles mit dem Auto von der Straße abgekommen, hatte sich mehrfach überschlagen und dabei komplizierte Brüche am Bein erlitten. Er lag drei Wochen im Krankenhaus und danach nach eigenen Angaben weitere drei Monate in einem Krankenbett bei sich zu Hause in Florida.
Damals gab es beim Golfstar Angaben von Polizei und Feuerwehr zufolge keine Anzeichen für den Einfluss von Alkohol, Drogen oder Medikamenten. Woods hatte nach dem Unfall zu Protokoll gegeben, sich nicht daran zu erinnern, am Steuer gesessen zu haben.
Gerüchte über Woods-Comeback
Woods hatte zuletzt Gerüchte um ein Comeback bei den ab dem 9. April stattfindenden US-Masters in Augusta befeuert. Der 50-Jährige hatte nach langer Verletzungspause am vergangenen Dienstag in der neuen Indoor-Liga Tomorrow's Golf League für Aufsehen gesorgt, als er dort überraschend einige Schläge machte.
Seinen letzten größeren Auftritt hatte Woods bei den British Open 2024. Nach einem Achillessehnenriss im Frühjahr 2025 fiel er für die Saison aus - und ließ sich im vergangenen Herbst dann ein weiteres Mal am Rücken operieren.
"Dieser Körper… Er erholt sich nicht mehr so wie damals, als ich 24, 25 war. Das heißt nicht, dass ich es nicht versuche", sagte Woods. Mit Blick auf die US-Masters ergänzte er: "Ich möchte spielen, ich liebe das Turnier." Er werde auf jeden Fall vor Ort sein, sagte der US-Amerikaner. "Wir werden sehen, wie es läuft. Ich werde diese Woche zu Hause trainieren und weiter versuchen, Fortschritte zu machen."

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods arrested for DUI after another rollover crash in Florida
sources.text:
Legendary golfer Tiger Woods was involved in a rollover crash near his home in Florida earlier on Friday.
The 15-time major winner was said to be in a rollover crash in Jupiter Island, Florida, with a photo taken by WPTV seemingly indicating that the car was rolled over onto the driver’s side.
One person involved in the accident is said to be ‘stable’, while another refused to go to the hospital. Martin County’s Sheriff’s department confirmed that Woods was arrested for a DUI.
The 50-year-old had just returned to golf, lining up in the TGL tournament in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, after recovering from yet another back surgery last October, as well as an Achilles tendon rupture. He was also supposedly weighing up whether to return to the Masters next week in Augusta.
Tiger Woods hasn’t competed on the PGA Tour since 2024 at The Open Championship at Royal Troon, where he missed the cut. The last time he made a cut was that same year at The Masters.
Woods was previously involved in a major car crash back in 2021. It was a single-car-crash where his SUV rolled over several times in Los Angeles, California. Woods had to undergo multiple surgeries for leg fractures and had a rod placed in his tibia, as well as having screws and pins inserted in his foot and ankle during emergency surgery.
Shortly after Woods revealed that he ‘lucky to be alive and also have a limb,’ saying that there was a real possibility that he could’ve lost part of his right leg.
The rehabilitation for that crash took months and years off of Woods’ career. Since then he has dealt with serious nback issues and mobility on the course.
He had a further surgery relating to the crash a couple of years later in 2023.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Arrested After Car Accident – because of Suspicion of Drunkenness
sources.text:
Sport-Fans weltweit sind in Sorge um Tiger Woods! Der legendäre Golf-Star war am Freitag (27. März) in einen schweren Autounfall verwickelt, bei dem sich sein Fahrzeug überschlug. Dramatische Bilder vom Unfallort zeigen den Wagen auf der Seite liegend – ein Anblick, der die Herzen seiner Fans höher schlagen lässt.
Am Abend teilte die Polizei weitere brisante Details zum Tathergang mit.
Tiger Woods in schwerem Unfall verwickelt
Der Vorfall ereignete sich im idyllischen Jupiter Island, Florida, einer Gegend, die Tiger Woods bestens kennt. Nach Angaben der örtlichen Polizei kam es gegen 14 Uhr Ortszeit zu dem Unglück.
WPTV, ein lokaler Fernsehsender, veröffentlichte ein Bild des Unfallwagens. Der Anblick ist erschreckend: Der Wagen liegt auf der Seite und lässt das Drama des Moments erahnen. Das Martin County Sheriffs Office bestätigte den Unfall, während der zuständige Sheriff John Budensiek am Nachmittag weitere Details angekündigt hat.
Am Abend machte Sheriff John Budensiek bei einer Pressekonferenz nähere Angaben zu dem Unfall. Das Wichtigste vorweg: Keiner der Beteiligten wurde bei dem Unfall verletzt. Nach ersten Erkenntnissen habe Woods mit seinem Landroover versucht, einen Lastwagen „mit hoher Geschwindigkeit“ zu überholen, sei dann aber ins Schleudern geraten und auf die Seite gekippt, so Budensiek.

Tiger Woods kurzzeitig in Haft
Die Golf-Legende wurde daraufhin festgenommen. Noch vor Ort wurde ein Atemalkoholtest durchgeführt, der negativ ausfiel. Budensiek fügte jedoch hinzu: „Als wir ihn um einen Urintest baten, weigerte er sich, und so wurde er wegen Fahrens unter Alkoholeinfluss, Sachbeschädigung und Verweigerung eines rechtmäßigen Tests angeklagt.“
Wenige Stunden später wurde Woods gegen eine Kautionszahlung wieder freigelassen.
Mehr aktuelle News:
Der Sheriff betonte, dass der Unfall durchaus viel schlimmer hätte ausgehen können. Erst 2017 war Woods in Jupiter, Florida, wegen des Verdachts auf Trunkenheit am Steuer verhaftet worden – damals fanden Beamte ihn schlafend in seinem Wagen. Vier Jahre später war er ebenfalls in einen schlimmen Unfall verwickelt, bei dem er sich mehrere Brüche zuzog. Es folgten zahlreiche Operationen. Erst 2025 feierte er sein Comeback im Golfsport.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Arrested for Drunk Driving After an Accident in Florida
sources.text:
Nouveau coup dur pour Tiger Woods. Le golfeur américain, 50 ans, a été arrêté ce vendredi 27 mars pour suspicion de conduite en état d’ivresse à Jupiter Island, en Floride, après que son SUV s’est retourné sur la chaussée. Il se trouve actuellement en détention.
L’incident s’est produit peu après 14h00 au 281 Beach Road, sur Jupiter Island. Selon le shérif du comté de Martin, John Budensiek, Tiger Woods conduisait un Land Rover sombre à haute vitesse lorsqu’il a percuté l’arrière d’une remorque tractée par un camion. Le conducteur du camion, qui s’apprêtait à tourner dans une allée, a déclaré avoir vu le SUV arriver à grande vitesse dans son rétroviseur. Le Land Rover a tenté d’éviter la collision en déportant sur la gauche, mais a quand même accroché la remorque avant de se retourner sur le côté conducteur. Aucune blessure n’est à déplorer.
À l’arrivée des secours, les agents ont suspecté que le golfeur était sous l’emprise d’une substance. Tiger Woods a accepté de souffler dans l’éthylomètre, qui a affiché un résultat à 0,00 — soit un taux d’alcool nul. En revanche, il a refusé de se soumettre au test urinaire. Il a expliqué aux enquêteurs avoir pris des médicaments pour ses blessures antérieures. En vertu de la loi floridienne, le refus du test urinaire entraîne automatiquement une inculpation pour conduite en état d’ivresse présumée. Il fait également face à une charge distincte pour refus de se soumettre aux tests.
Ce n’est pas la première fois que Tiger Woods se retrouve dans ce type de situation. En 2017, il avait été arrêté en Floride pour conduite sous l’emprise de médicaments. Il avait alors plaidé coupable de conduite imprudente, réglé une amende de 250 dollars et suivi un programme de sensibilisation. Woods souffre depuis des années de douleurs chroniques liées à de nombreuses opérations du dos et du genou.
L’arrestation survient à un moment particulièrement délicat : le Masters d’Augusta, l’un des quatre tournois du Grand Chelem, se tient dans quelques jours. Tiger Woods, qui comptait parmi les possibles participants, voit sa présence désormais compromise. Aucune réaction officielle n’a été communiquée par son entourage au moment où nous publions.
Tiger Woods reste présumé innocent jusqu’à ce que sa culpabilité soit établie par une décision de justice définitive.
Sources : CNN · NBC News · The Guardian

sources.text:
Mississippi, known as the **Magnolia State**, captivates visitors with its rich Delta blues heritage, Civil War history, Gulf Coast beaches, and warm Southern hospitality. The state offers a soulful blend of music, literature, outdoor adventures, and flavorful cuisine, making it a perfect destination for history buffs, music lovers, beachgoers, and road-trippers seeking authentic Mississippi culture experiences.
**Jackson**, the capital, acts as a cultural gateway where you can explore the **Mississippi Civil Rights Museum** and the **Museum of Mississippi History** for powerful exhibits. Don't miss the **Mississippi Museum of Natural Science**, complete with an aquarium and beautiful trails. Take a leisurely stroll through the **Old Capitol Museum** and indulge in farm-to-table dining downtown. Spending 1–2 days in Jackson serves as an excellent base for exploring the area.
**Natchez**, located on the banks of the Mississippi River, shines with its antebellum mansions and the picturesque **Natchez Trace Parkway**—a 444-mile historic route ideal for scenic drives, hikes, and cycling through lush forests and stunning overlooks. Tour grand homes like Stanton Hall or Longwood during the Spring Pilgrimage.
**Oxford**, home to the University of Mississippi (“Ole Miss”), delights book lovers with literary landmarks such as Rowan Oak (William Faulkner’s home) and Square Books. The town buzzes with college vibes, tailgating, and delicious Southern fare.
For Delta blues enthusiasts, **Clarksdale** is a must-visit for the Crossroads, the **Delta Blues Museum**, and live juke-joint music, while **Greenwood** offers a deeper dive into this rich heritage. Additionally, **Tupelo** celebrates Elvis Presley’s humble beginnings with a dedicated museum.
The **Gulf Coast** (including Biloxi, Gulfport, and Ocean Springs) presents pristine white-sand beaches, casinos like Beau Rivage, fresh seafood, and the **Mississippi Aquarium**. You can take a ferry to **Ship Island** for stunning beaches at the Gulf Islands National Seashore and explore historical forts. sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Is Arrested by Dui in Florida After He Dumps His Truck: Do You Miss the Masters 2026?

Tiger Woods es arrestado por DUI en Florida tras volcar su camioneta: ¿Se pierde el Masters 2026?
COMPARTIR
TEMAS
Localizaciones
Personajes
Organizaciones
El histórico golfista estadounidense fue detenido en Jupiter Island, luego de verse involucrado en un accidente vehicular que derivó en cargos por conducir bajo influencia, daños a propiedad y negativa a realizar una prueba solicitada por las autoridades
Tiger Woods volvió a colocarse en el centro de la atención internacional, esta vez lejos de los campos de golf. El exnúmero uno del mundo fue arrestado en Jupiter Island, Florida, después de sufrir una volcadura mientras conducía un Land Rover en una zona residencial cercana a su domicilio.
De acuerdo con reportes de autoridades locales y medios internacionales, el vehículo del golfista intentó rebasar a alta velocidad a una camioneta de trabajo con remolque, terminó golpeando la unidad y acabó volcado.
Las autoridades señalaron que Woods mostraba signos de afectación al momento del incidente. Aunque la prueba de alcoholemia no detectó alcohol en su organismo, el sheriff del condado de Martin indicó que el deterioro observado podría estar relacionado con medicamentos o alguna otra sustancia.
Además, el deportista se negó a proporcionar una muestra de orina, por lo que fue detenido y enfrenta cargos menores por DUI, daños a propiedad y negativa a someterse a una prueba legal.
El accidente no dejó lesionados de gravedad. Woods logró salir por su cuenta del vehículo, mientras que el conductor de la otra unidad involucrada tampoco resultó herido.
Sin embargo, el episodio reabre el historial del ganador de 15 majors con incidentes al volante, luego de su arresto de 2017 y del fuerte accidente automovilístico que sufrió en 2021, el cual puso en riesgo su carrera e incluso una de sus piernas.
A sus 50 años, Tiger Woods atravesaba una etapa de incertidumbre física y competitiva, con la mira puesta en definir si podría aparecer en el Masters 2026. Esta nueva detención golpea su imagen pública y añade dudas sobre su panorama inmediato dentro del golf profesional.
Deberá permanecer bajo custodia al menos ocho horas conforme a la legislación de Florida antes de poder optar por una liberación bajo fianza.
Para Woods, el impacto no solo será legal, sino también deportivo, en un momento en que su regreso al máximo nivel parecía depender de cada paso fuera y dentro del campo.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods arrested at crash scene on suspicion of DUI
sources.text:
JUPITER ISLAND, Fla. (AP) — Tiger Woods showed signs of impairment at the scene of a car crash Friday in which he struck another vehicle and rolled over, authorities said.
Woods was arrested on suspicion of DUI. The Martin County Sheriff’s Office said Woods was not injured.
THIS IS A BREAKING NEWS UPDATE. AP’s earlier story follows below.
JUPITER ISLAND, Fla. (AP) — Tiger Woods was involved in a car crash on Friday, the Martin County Sheriff’s Office said.
Authorities told media outlets the rollover crash occurred just after 1 p.m. not far from where Woods lives on Jupiter Island. Martin County Fire Rescue said there were no serious injuries, CBS 12 reported.
Woods’ manager at Excel Sports did not immediately respond to a text message seeking information.
This was at least the third time Woods has been involved in a car crash, most recently in February 2021 when his SUV ran off a coastal road in Los Angeles at a high rate of speed, leading to multiple leg and ankle injuries. Woods said later doctors considered amputation.
Woods has played 11 tournaments since that 2021 crash, not finishing closer than within 16 shots of the winner the four times he finished 72 holes.
He also was arrested on a DUI charge in 2017 when south Florida police found him asleep behind the wheel of his car that was parked awkwardly with damage to the driver’s side. Woods said he had taken a bad mix of painkillers. He later pleaded guilty to reckless driving.
Woods won his fifth Masters, and 15th major, in 2019. He has 82 wins on the PGA Tour, tied for the all-time record with Sam Snead.
Woods, 50, had been working his way back to golf from a seventh back surgery in September. He had not decided whether he could play in the Masters on April 9-12.
His last official tournament was the British Open in 2024. Woods ruptured his Achilles tendon in March 2025 and that kept him off the course all season even before the back surgery. He managed to play in his indoor TGL golf league on Tuesday night.
He has kept deeply involved in PGA Tour affairs as chairman of the Future Competition Committee that is restructuring the model of the tour.
Woods also faced a soft deadline at the end of the month to decide whether to become U.S. Ryder Cup captain for the 2027 matches in Ireland. Woods was offered the job for the last Ryder Cup and did not turn it down until June. The PGA of America wants a decision much sooner this time.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods has been arrested and jailed after being involved in car crash in Jupiter Island, Florida
sources.text:
Tiger Woods has been charged with driving under the influence after being involved in car crash in Jupiter Island, Florida
Tiger Woods charged with driving under the influence, property damage and refusal to submit to a lawful test after being involved in rollover crash – five years after near-fatal accident left him fearing he'd lose leg; golfer released on bail in early hours of Saturday morning
Saturday 28 March 2026 07:22, UK
Tiger Woods has been released on bail after being charged with driving under the influence following his involvement in a car crash in Florida.
The 15-time major winner was taken to jail after his vehicle rolled over following a collision with a trailer he was attempting to overtake.
Woods walked away unhurt but was described as "lethargic" by officers, and police believe he was "impaired on medication". He took a breathalyser test at the scene which returned negative, but refused to submit a urine sample.
The 50-year-old was kept in jail for eight hours before being released on bond in the early hours on Saturday morning.
Sheriff John Budensiek told reporters Woods had also been charged with property damage and refusal to submit to a lawful test. The offences are not felonies.
Budensiek said Woods showed "signs of impairment" after the incident in Florida, which happened shortly after 2pm local time on Friday and happened in the same town where Woods lives.
He was also charged with property damage and refusal to submit to a lawful test. No injuries were reported.
Photos from the scene showed the vehicle lying on the driver's side.
Budensiek said: "The DUI investigators came to the scene and Mr Woods did exemplify signs of impairment.
"They did several tests on him. He did explain the injuries and surgeries that he's had and we did take that into account, but they did so some in-depth roadside tests.
"When it was determined, he was placed under arrest and taken to the Martin County jail.
"At the Martin County jail, and even on scene, we were really not suspicious of alcohol being involved in this case and that proved to be true.
"Mr Woods did a breathalyser test with triple zeros, but when it came time for us to ask for a urinary analysis test, he refused and so he has been charged with DUI, property damage and refusal to submit to a lawful test."
Budensiek added that Woods had been driving at "high speed" and his vehicle tipped on to its side and then "slid for a pretty decent space before he came to a stop".
The speed limit on the road in question was 30mph. The driver of the other vehicle was also unhurt.
Woods' previous car crashes
Personal scandal (November 2009)
Woods enjoyed a meteoric rise to stardom, but his fall from grace was equally spectacular. His private life unravelled dramatically after he crashed his car into a fire hydrant and a tree outside his home in Windermere, Florida. Admissions of serial infidelity followed and led to him taking a break from the game as he received therapy and dealt with the personal humiliation.
DUI (May 2017)
Just weeks after his spinal surgery, Woods was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence when he was found asleep at the wheel of his car in Jupiter, Florida. He later pleaded guilty to reckless driving. It emerged that he had had five prescription drugs in his system at the time and he spent 11 months on probation. During his return to action in November 2017, Woods revealed the depth of his physical struggles. "I've been in bed for about two years and haven't been able to do much," Woods said.
Serious car accident (February 2021)
Woods required multiple surgeries for leg and ankle injuries following a rollover car crash in Los Angeles. Fire crews had to use 'jaws of life' cutting equipment to remove him from the wreckage of his vehicle after he lost control at high speed on a winding stretch of road. He did not play competitive golf again for 15 months and has had numerous health and injury problems since.
Weir: Damaging day for Woods
Speaking to Sky Sports News, golf correspondent Jamie Weir said: "What is the biggest fallout from this and I think the answer has to be reputational damage for Tiger Woods. This is hugely embarrassing to be arrested for driving under the influence, to spend eight hours in a Florida jail, for questions to arise to what was in his system having refused to take that urine test?
"This is the third time he has been involved in a car crash and this has echoes of 2017.
"There are lots of people thinking the bank account is healthy enough, surely he can afford a driver to take him places because he's putting himself, and most importantly, other road users and pedestrians at risk.
"This is another damaging day for Woods reputationally."
Will arrest derail Woods' bid for Masters return?
Talking on Back Pages Tonight, ESPN's Mark Ogden thinks that Tiger Woods won't feature at the Masters after his arrest and being charged with driving under the influence.
Woods working towards competitive action
Woods has been working toward a return to competitive golf after rupturing an Achilles tendon in March 2025 and undergoing back surgery last October.
He competed for the first time in more than a year during Tuesday's TGL finals, where his Jupiter Links GC team lost to the Los Angeles Golf Club. He had not decided whether to play in the Masters from April 9-12.
Woods has been playing a limited schedule since being involved in a car crash that occurred in Southern California in February 2021 in which the vehicle rolled several times and left him trapped inside.
The golf great later had surgery to deal with open fractures to his lower right leg, a rod placed in a tibia, and had screws and pins inserted in his foot and ankle during emergency surgery.
Woods later said doctors considered amputation.
Following the accident, Woods began a rehabilitation process that included three months in a hospital-type bed in his home.
He had at least one more surgery related to injuries from the crash in April 2023.
In 2017, Woods was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence in Jupiter, Florida.
An incident report at the time said that he was asleep and "had to be woken up." Woods was later released on his own recognisance.
Woods shared a statement after the incident apologising to his family, friends and fans.
Trump feels 'so badly' for Woods
Donald Trump said he feels "so badly" after hearing about Woods' latest crash.
The US president hailed the 50-year-old as a "very close friend of mine" but said he didn't want to talk about the collision.
"I feel so badly," he said. "He's got some difficulty. There was an accident, and that's all I know.
"Very close friend of mine. He's an amazing person.
"Amazing man. But, some difficulty. I don't want to talk about it."
On Thursday, Trump claimed Woods will not play at the Masters but that he will be there to watch, despite the golfer saying only days ago that he'll he'll be trying everything to play at the tournament where he has a lifetime eligibility.
After recovering from back surgery last October, months after rupturing his Achilles tendon, Woods, 50, has been in contention to return to competitive golf for the first time since The Open in the summer of 2024.
Speaking to Fox News programme The Five, Trump stated: "I love Tiger, but he won't be there. He'll be there, but he won't be playing in it."
The five-time Masters winner indicated he remained hopeful of competing, stating he is "trying" to participate despite ongoing physical challenges.
"I've been trying. It's just this body doesn't recover like when I was 24, 25," Woods said.
"It doesn't mean I'm not trying - I've been trying for a while."
In 2000-2001, Woods became the only player to win all four majors in succession.
The last time Woods won a major was in 2019, at the Masters.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Charged With DUI After Rollover Accident In Florida
sources.text:
Florida authorities reported that Tiger Woods was arrested and charged with driving under the influence on Friday afternoon after he was involved in a rollover crash.
The crash happened shortly before 2 p.m. in Jupiter Island, the Martin County Sheriff’s Office said. There were no injuries in the crash, which also involved a truck pulling a trailer.
According to law enforcement officials, Woods, 50, was driving a dark Land Rover and clipped the truck.
Woods’ SUV rolled on the driver’s side door. The golfer climbed out of the window, officials said.
Neither Woods nor the truck driver were injured.
Law enforcement officers suspected Woods of impairment. He agreed to a breath test but refused a urine test. Officials stated that he claimed to have taken medication for previous injuries.
In 2021, the golfer was injured in a rollover crash in Rolling Hills Estates in Southern California. Authorities reported that the driver was exceeding the speed limit by at least twice in a 45 mph zone when his Genesis GV80 SUV collided with a tree. As a result, the vehicle was airborne and subsequently landed on its side.
Officials initially reported no signs of impairment, but this revelation sparked some criticism. The investigation faced scrutiny for not obtaining a search warrant for the golfer’s blood samples, which could have revealed any evidence of alcohol or drugs.
Woods was not charged in that 2021 crash.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods in Car Accident in Florida – Was Under the Influence of Drugs
sources.text:
Tiger Woods i bilulykke i Florida – var ruspåvirket
Golfstjernen Tiger Woods havnet i en trafikkulykke i Florida fredag ettermiddag, lokal tid. Han var ruspåvirket, opplyser politiet.
– Like før 14 fikk Jupiter-politiet melding om en ulykke. Politiet rykket ut og fant en pickup-truck og en Land Rover som hadde tippet over på siden, sier John Budensiek, sheriff i Martin County fredag kveld.
Videre forteller politiet at det umiddelbart virket som at føreren av bilen som veltet, virket å være ruspåvirket.
– Føreren av Land Roveren var Tiger Woods. Han var påvirket og ble da arrestert, forteller Budensiek.
Alkoholmåleren slo ikke ut for alkohol, men politiet mener at han var påvirket av narkotika eller medisiner.
– Nektet
Sheriffen forteller at Woods samarbeider med politiet, men at han ikke ønsker å inkriminere seg selv.
– Så han var forsiktig med hva han sa til oss, fortell Budensiek og legger til:
– Han nektet å ta urinprøve. Så vi kommer aldri til å få et definitivt svar på hvor påvirket han var.
Woods er siktet for kjøring i påvirket tilstand, skadeverk og for å nekte å la seg teste for rus.
Woods ble senere fredag, natt til lørdag norsk tid, sluppet fri etter åtte timer i varetekt.
På siden
På spørsmål om hastigheten da ulykken fant sted, svarer sheriffen at de ikke har svaret på det per tid, men at fartsgrensen på stedet var 30 miles per hour, rundt 50 kilometer i timen, og at bildene politiet tok viser at bilen skled såpass langt mens den var på siden at farten må ha vært høyere.
Det skal ikke ha blitt funnet medikamenter i bilen til Woods, og verken golfstjernen eller andre involverte i ulykken skal ha blitt skadet.
Et bilde hos WPTV viser at bilen ligger på siden.
New York Post opplyser også at Woods' kjæreste, Vanessa Trump, og hennes datter Kai Trump ikke var i bilen da ulykken skjedde.
Kai Trump er barnebarnet til USAs president Donald Trump, mens Vanessa Trump tidligere var gift med presidentens eldste sønn, Donald jr.
Overlevde ulykke i 2021
Tiger Woods ble alvorlig skadet da han kjørte ut i California i 2021.
Den gang ble det sagt at han var heldig som overlevde, og at han antagelig kan takke bilbeltet for det. Undersøkelser viste at bilen holdt høy fart da ulykken skjedde den gang.
Etter dette har han spilt få turneringer og aldri kommet tilbake på toppnivået sitt.
I 2017 ble Woods pågrepet på grunn av mistanke om kjøring i påvirket tilstand.
En av de største
Tiger Woods er en av de største mannlige golfspillerne gjennom tidene, og står blant annet med 15 seirer i såkalte «Major-turneringer», golfsportens største turneringer.
Til sammen har den 50 år gamle golfspilleren vunnet Masters-turneringen fem ganger, senest i 2019.
Tidligere fredag ble det meldt at han hadde registrert seg for seniorturneringen i US Open.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Is Arrested After Being Involved in an Accident - 27/03/2026
sources.text:
O astro do golfe Tiger Woods foi preso e acusado de dirigir sob influência de álcool após se envolver em um acidente de carro com capotamento na Flórida, nesta sexta-feira (27), mas posteriormente foi liberado, informaram as autoridades.
Woods, que não sofreu ferimentos no acidente, foi preso depois que o veículo que dirigia colidiu com um reboque e capotou, tombando sobre o lado do motorista.
O xerife do Condado de Martin, John Budensiek, afirmou que o golfista de 50 anos estava com as "faculdades comprometidas", embora tenha passado no teste do bafômetro.
"Mas, quando chegou o momento de solicitar um exame de urina, ele se recusou e, consequentemente, foi indiciado por dirigir sob o efeito de substâncias, causar danos materiais e se recusar a passar por exame legal após o acidente", acrescentou Budensiek.
De acordo com o policial, Woods estava ultrapassando o reboque em alta velocidade quando o atingiu lateralmente e capotou. Para sair do veículo, ele teve que usar a porta do passageiro.
Peritos da polícia o avaliaram no local e determinaram que ele "não estava alcoolizado, mas sob influência de algum tipo de medicamento ou droga", disse o xerife.
O golfista foi preso na tarde desta sexta-feira e, de acordo com a lei da Flórida, deveria permanecer sob custódia por um mínimo de oito horas a partir do momento de sua prisão. Após o prazo, ele foi liberado e deixou a delegacia com um acompanhante
Woods já sofreu um grave acidente de carro na Califórnia em 2021, que o deixou com lesões graves e permanentes na perna direita.
O vencedor de 15 torneios de Grand Slam, que passou por várias cirurgias, admitiu mais tarde que esteve perto de ter a perna amputada.
Woods retornou ao circuito no Masters de Augusta de 2022, onde terminou na 47ª colocação, apesar de ter tido dificuldades para caminhar pelo campo.
Nas últimas semanas, ele vinha trabalhando para retornar às competições, após uma ruptura do tendão de Aquiles sofrida em março do ano passado e uma cirurgia nas costas realizada em outubro.
Ainda nesta semana, ele fez seu retorno nas finais da TGL, uma competição de golfe virtual indoor, e não descartou participar do Masters, que acontece em abril.
Em 2017, Woods também se envolveu em um incidente de trânsito no qual foi preso sob suspeita de dirigir sob a influência de álcool ou drogas.
Posteriormente, ele se declarou culpado por dirigir de forma imprudente, pagou uma multa de US$ 250 (R$ cerca de 1.300) e frequentou uma escola de trânsito.
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, reagiu à notícia ao chegar a Miami nesta sexta-feira.
"Lamento muito, ele está passando por algumas dificuldades. Houve um acidente e é só isso o que sei. Ele é um amigo muito próximo meu, é uma pessoa incrível, um homem incrível, mas, hã... algumas dificuldades", disse Trump.

Os comentários não representam a opinião do jornal; a responsabilidade é do autor da mensagem.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods charged with DUI after car crash, released on bail
sources.text:
JUPITER ISLAND, Fla. — Tiger Woods was released on bail Friday, hours after his Land Rover clipped a truck, rolled onto its side and he was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence, according to officials.
Woods, who was not injured in the crash, was released on bail, according to Christine Weiss, a spokesperson for the Martin County Sheriff’s Office. Florida law required that he spend at least eight hours in jail before he could post bail.
Martin County Sheriff John Budensiek said Woods had been traveling at “high speeds” on a residential road and after the crash showed “signs of impairment,” adding that investigators believe he had taken some kind of medication or drug. He described Woods as lethargic and said he agreed to a Breathalyzer test that showed no signs of alcohol, but refused a urine test and was arrested.
Woods’ manager at Excel Sports did not immediately respond to a text message seeking comment.
This was the fourth time Woods has been involved in a car crash, most recently in February 2021 when his SUV ran off a coastal road in Los Angeles at a high rate of speed, leading to multiple leg and ankle injuries.
It was the second time Woods has been arrested for a DUI not as a result of the influence of alcohol. He said he took a bad mix of painkillers when authorities found him in 2017 asleep behind the wheel of his car, the engine still running and its driver's side damaged. Woods pleaded guilty then to reckless driving.
President Donald Trump, whose former daughter-in-law is dating Tiger Woods, was asked about the golfer when he landed in Miami on Friday afternoon for an investment summit.
“I feel so badly. He’s got some difficulty,” Trump said. “Very close friend of mine. He’s an amazing person. Amazing man. But, some difficulty.”
The crash occurred just before 2 p.m. not far from where Woods lives on Jupiter Island.
Budensiek said Woods attempted to pass a pressure cleaner truck while driving on a two-lane road with a 30 mph (48 kph) speed limit. He said authorities could not determine how fast Woods was going.
The Land Rover swerved to avoid a collision as he was passing the truck but clipped the back end of the truck’s trailer, Budensiek said. Woods’ car then rolled onto its driver’s side.
The sheriff said Woods was “cooperative, but he's not trying to incriminate himself.” He said Woods has the right to refuse the urine test and that authorities “will never get definitive results with what he was impaired on.”
Woods’ manager at Excel Sports did not immediately respond to a text message seeking comment.
This was the fourth time Woods has been involved in a car crash, most recently in February 2021 when his SUV ran off a coastal road in Los Angeles at a high rate of speed, leading to multiple leg and ankle injuries. Woods said later doctors considered amputation. He also previously sustained multiple injuries to his left knee and his back during his golf career.
Woods returned from multiple back surgeries to win the 2019 Masters for his 15th major. His 82 titles on the PGA Tour is tied for the career record with Sam Snead. Since that LA crash, he has played 11 tournaments without being closer than 16 shots to the winner the four times he was able to finish 72 holes.
Friday's arrest comes as Woods was trying to decide if he was fit enough to play the Masters, which starts April 9. He also was to be in Augusta, Georgia, on April 5 to unveil a golf course project with Masters chairman Fred Ridley.
Woods also was days away from what was described as a “soft deadline” to decide whether to be the U.S. Ryder Cup captain for the 2027 matches in Ireland.
Woods, 50, had been working his way back to golf from a seventh back surgery in September.
His last official tournament was the British Open in 2024. Woods ruptured his Achilles tendon in March 2025 and that kept him off the course all season even before the back surgery. He managed to play in his indoor TGL golf league on Tuesday night.
He has remained deeply involved in PGA Tour affairs as chair of the Future Competition Committee that is restructuring the model of the tour.

sources.news_title: Tiger Woods Arrested Accused of Driving Under Alcohol Effects on Jupiter Island · Global Voices
sources.text:
La superestrella del golf Tiger Woods fue puesto en libertad bajo fianza el viernes, horas después de que su Land Rover chocara contra un camión, volcara de lado y fuera arrestado bajo sospecha de conducir bajo los efectos del alcohol en Florida, informaron las autoridades.
El accidente ocurrió poco antes de las 2:00 p. m. en Jupiter Island, informó la Oficina del Sheriff del condado de Martin.
Noticias de Florida 24/7 en Telemundo 51.
No hubo heridos en el accidente, en el que también se vio involucrado un camión que remolcaba un tráiler.
Según los agentes del orden, Woods, de 50 años, conducía un Land Rover de color oscuro y rozó el camión.
El conductor del camión relató a los agentes que estaba comenzando a girar para entrar en un camino de acceso desde una carretera de dos carriles cuando miró por el espejo y vio a Woods conduciendo "a gran velocidad", informaron las autoridades el viernes por la tarde.
Cuando el conductor del camión intentó salir de la carretera, el Land Rover "adelantó" al camión en el último instante; Woods dio un volantazo para evitar la colisión, pero finalmente rozó la parte trasera del tráiler.
El SUV de Woods volcó y quedó apoyado sobre la puerta del lado del conductor. El golfista salió del vehículo a través de la ventanilla, indicaron las autoridades.
Local
Ni Woods ni el conductor del camión sufrieron heridas.
Los agentes que acudieron al lugar sospecharon que Woods se encontraba bajo los efectos de alguna sustancia. El golfista accedió a someterse a una prueba de alcoholemia (de aliento), pero se negó a realizarse una prueba de orina, señalaron las autoridades. Woods comunicó a los agentes que había tomado medicamentos para tratar lesiones previas, añadieron las autoridades.
Fue arrestado en el lugar de los hechos y trasladado a una cárcel local.
La estrella del golf enfrenta también un cargo por negarse a someterse a una prueba, informaron las autoridades.
A principios de esta semana, el martes, Woods disputó un partido correspondiente a las finales de la *Tomorrow’s Golf League*, en el que su equipo, el Jupiter Links Golf Club, perdió ante el Los Angeles Golf Club.
En 2021, el golfista resultó herido en un accidente con vuelco ocurrido en Rolling Hills Estates, en el sur de California. Las autoridades informaron entonces que Woods conducía a una velocidad de al menos el doble del límite permitido —fijado en 45 millas por hora— cuando su SUV Genesis GV80 chocó contra un árbol, lo que provocó que el vehículo saliera despedido por el aire y aterrizara volcado sobre uno de sus costados.
Woods sufrió heridas de gravedad en aquel accidente anterior.
En aquel momento, las autoridades declararon que no existían indicios de que el golfista se encontrara bajo los efectos de sustancias, si bien dicha conclusión generó cierta controversia. Los investigadores fueron objeto de críticas por no haber solicitado una orden judicial para obtener las muestras de sangre del golfista, las cuales habrían permitido detectar cualquier posible rastro de alcohol o drogas.
Woods no fue imputado por aquel accidente de 2021. El atleta se había internado previamente en una clínica en 2017 para recibir medicación con receta, tras haber sido arrestado ese mismo año en Florida por conducir bajo los efectos de sustancias.
Este artículo fue publicado originalmente en inglés por Minyvonne Burke y Alicia Victoria Lozano para nuestra cadena hermana NBC News.
